text:
tyler: Quick PR to finalize audit-export docs. Goals: add a short migration note (old export -> exports.create), a redaction/field-inclusion callout, a tiny Go SDK snippet, and a sanitized curl example. Draft: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1628
nina: Can you paste the examples here so we can scan for PII and wording?
tyler: Curl example (sanitized):
```bash
curl -X POST \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit-exports\" \\
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer <API_KEY>\" \\
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\
  -d '{"filter":{"start":"2024-08-01T00:00:00Z","end":"2024-08-31T23:59:59Z","events":["access","policy.update"]},"destination":{"type":"s3","bucket":"<EXPORT_BUCKET>"}}'
```
tyler: Go SDK snippet (new method):
```go
// old: client.Audit().ExportLogs(ctx, start, end)
// new:
job, err := client.Audit().CreateExport(ctx, audit.CreateExportParams{
  Filter: audit.Filter{Start: \"2024-08-01T00:00:00Z\", End: \"2024-08-31T23:59:59Z\", Events: []string{\"access\"}},
  Destination: audit.Destination{Type: \"s3\", Bucket: \"<EXPORT_BUCKET>\"},
})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
fmt.Println(job.ID)
```
sam: A few compliance notes: 1) For SOC2-safe wording prefer \"Retention is configurable per-org and data type\" rather than blanket storage claims. 2) Add a short redaction note: \"By default audit exports contain internal identifiers; fields that may contain PII are not included unless explicitly configured by the customer and subject to data-classification controls.\" Keep it short.
compliance-bot: Policy reminder: public docs must not include real emails, IP addresses, SSNs, ARNs, or credentials. Use placeholders or masked/internal ids. Also recommended: a UTC note (all sample timestamps use Z).
nina: Also add a one-line about redaction configuration link and retention auditability: \"Retention and redaction config changes are logged as policy.update events in the audit stream.\" Point to /docs/compliance/retention and /docs/compliance/data-classification.
tyler: Good catches. I'll add: 1) short migration bullet at top: \"legacy client.Audit().ExportLogs -> client.Audit().CreateExport; payload now requires Destination.\" 2) redaction sentence per Sam, 3) UTC note, 4) links to retention + data-classification, and 5) disclaimer above examples: \"Examples use masked/internal identifiers and are illustrative only.\" I'll push the update in ~15m and ping.
docs-bot: Pre-merge checks queued: link validation, PII scan, and anchor check for /console/audit#exports.
tyler: Update pushed with the migration bullet, redaction callout, UTC note, links, and disclaimer. CI shows link checks + PII scan passing. Marking resolved. :white_check_mark:
